Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.

Location

This is a remote role.

About The Job You’re Considering

As a Quality Manager / Test Automation Lead responsible for defining and driving enterprise-wide quality engineering strategy across SAP S/4HANA and integrated business landscapes. This role combines deep hands-on expertise in Tricentis Tosca with SAP transformation experience and requires strong capabilities to architect end-to-end integration between SAP, Signavio BPM, SAP Cloud ALM, and automated testing frameworks.

Your Role

• Define and lead SAP test automation strategy using Tricentis Tosca across S/4HANA and integrated business processes.
• Architect scalable, reusable automation frameworks for end-to-end, regression, and integration testing.
• Design and implement integration between SAP Signavio (process modeling), SAP Cloud ALM (test orchestration), and Tosca (test automation).
• Lead cross-functional collaboration across business, IT, QA, and SAP functional teams to align testing with business processes.
• Establish and govern test data management (provisioning, masking, refresh, synthetic data) to ensure execution readiness.
• Drive quality engineering practices, automation coverage, KPIs, and continuous improvement across testing cycles.
• Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts and frameworks using Tosca for SAP and integrated systems.
• Ensure end-to-end process validation across SAP modules and interfacing systems (APIs, middleware, web applications).
• Define and implement best practices for automation frameworks, CI/CD integration, and version control.
• Analyze test execution results, identify defects, and drive root cause analysis and defect resolution.
• Lead release readiness activities including test planning, execution, and go/no-go recommendations.
• Support pre-sales and growth initiatives through solutioning, RFP responses, client workshops, and value articulation.
• Lead stakeholder engagement and mentor teams to build automation capabilities, reusable assets, and delivery excellence.
• Evaluate emerging QA tools, AI-driven testing innovations, and SAP testing accelerators.

Your Skills And Experience

• 10+ years of QA/testing experience with at least 5+ years in SAP testing and automation.
• Hands-on expertise with Tricentis Tosca for automation of SAP (GUI, Fiori, APIs) and non-SAP applications.
• Experience with API testing (Postman, Rest Assured).
• Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
• Proven ability to mentor teams and scale automation capability.
• Strong knowledge of and experience with automation frameworks.

Preferred Skills & Experience

• Strong experience in SAP S/4HANA implementations and business process testing.
• Experience with SAP Signavio for process modeling and SAP Cloud ALM for test lifecycle management.
• Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, Azure DevOps.
• Strong knowledge of test data management strategies and tools.
• Strong SQL/database skills.
• Programming/scripting experience (Java, Python, or similar).
• Experience integrating automation into DevOps pipelines.

Who We Are:

Aurelius Systems is a VC backed defense tech startup building autonomous, edge deployed directed energy systems for counter-UAS. We build laser weapons to shoot down drones.

We're a small team of engineers, former US military operators, and subject matter experts scaling America's directed energy dominance. The first cost effective, reliable and robust laser weapon system.

Our namesake isn't an accident. Marcus Aurelius wrote about doing the work in front of you, every day, without excuses. Henry Ford didn't wait for permission to reinvent manufacturing. That's how we operate — small team, unreasonable output, no hiding behind the unachievable.

In addition to our San Francisco lab, we’ve opened a Detroit manufacturing hub and we field test weekly on our own 400-acre private range.

The Role and Your Impact:

We need a Robotics Software, QA Test Engineer who lives in the lab and owns software cleanliness for Archimedes. You'll partner directly with our Principal Robotics SWE on CI/CD, regression infrastructure, and the pipeline that gets code from commit to a working system in the field. Test is a first-class engineering function here. You're a test builder for robotics system performance and validation, not a gatekeeper.

What You'll Own:
• Robotics test infrastructure across unit, integration, end-to-end, and hardware-in-the-loop
• CI/CD pipelines, build health, and release gates
• Regression suites and automated test coverage across the robotics stack
• Bug triage and reproducibility — you find it, you reproduce it, you own it until it's fixed
• Release cleanliness for fielded software
• Lab time on real hardware, not test management from behind a desk

What We're Looking For:
• 3+ years building test infrastructure for robotics, hardware,
• Strong Python and C++ test skills
• Built CI/CD pipelines from scratch and operated them in production
• Hardware-in-the-loop or rig-based testing experience
• Comfortable on real hardware, not just simulators

Where you probably come from: QA or test infrastructure roles at defense, robotics, automotive autonomy, automation tooling, or anywhere with HIL test rigs.

We want to talk if: You think test is a first-class engineering discipline, not a stage gate. You've built test infrastructure from scratch and you actually use it.

Not a fit if: Your background is manual QA only, you've never shipped a CI pipeline you built yourself, or you've never debugged on real hardware.

Nice to Haves:
• Robotics Software testing experience
• Hardware-in-the-loop rig design
• Performance and stress testing on real-time systems
• Defense or safety-critical software release experience

Education:

BS in CS, EE, or equivalent. Track record matters more than degree

How You Operate:
• Extreme bias for action. You ship working test infrastructure, not test plans
• You debug from first principles, not intuition alone
• Comfortable with ambiguity and fast iteration in a startup environment
• Clear communicator across software, hardware, and engineering teams
• Self directed. You identify what needs to happen next and do it without being told

Why Join Aurelius Systems?
• Build more in 1 month than most engineers build in 1 year. We field test weekly. Your work goes downrange, not into a filing cabinet.
• Career velocity is real. At ~10 engineers, there are no layers between you and impact.
• Work on a problem that actually matters. Small cheap drones are changing warfare. Our laser systems are the asymmetric answer — infinite magazine, near zero cost per shot, scalable to every base, border, facility, and truck.
• Join the densest defense startup ecosystem in the country. California is where the next generation of defense companies are being built.

How We Work:

Core hours are Monday through Friday, 9 to 6. When we're sprinting toward a demo or field test, the team ramps up — nights, weekends, whatever it takes to ship. When the sprint lands, we ramp down. We don't manufacture intensity for show.

Benefits:

• United Health Care medical, dental, and vision coverage
• Flexible 18 days PTO + 5 sick days
• Travel to field test events and range days
• Covered daily lunches and office snacks + drinks
• E-bike / scooter stipend ( Up to $500)
• Direct access to leadership and real ownership over your work
